# X3 — open first along the lines of descent (generated by `lod_openfirst.py`)

Input `runs/lod_v6_modal/lod_v6`; founders `results/lod/founders2.csv`; 17 closed worlds (worlds with founders), 1088 sampled lines.

On each sampled line every distinct tape from step 0 to the line's founder is classed against 64 random partners as in N3 (`lod_traj.classify_tapes`). The first copier is the earliest record on the line whose tape is an open or a confined copier. The founder on each line is located with `lod_chain.py`'s rule and checked against `founders2.csv`.

## Scores

- **X3-1** (first copier on every sampled line open in ≥ 90% of closed worlds): 17 of 17 worlds (1.000) — **met**.
- **X3-2** (no world in which a confined copier on a line precedes that line's first open copier by more than 79 steps): 0 such worlds — **met**.

## Checks

- lines with a founder by `lod_chain.py`'s rule: 1088 of 1088
- founders on lines that are in `founders2.csv`: 1088 of 1088; distinct founders reached by the lines: 32 (founders2.csv: 32)
- every line starts at a step-0 record: True
- distinct tapes classed (cache `open_first_classes.csv`): 96750

## First copiers

- first-copier classes over all lines: open copier 1088
- step of the first copier: median 342 (range 5–2703)
- steps from the first open copier to the founder: median 36361 (range 2452–64939)
- lines on which the earliest confined copier is the founder itself: 739 of 1088
- first-copier tapes (lines; copy, enter and exact rates against the 64 partners): `01 c5 01 c5 01 c5 01 c5 01 c5 01 c5 01 c5 01 c5` (639; 0.703, 1.000, 0.469); `ff 41 00 41 00 41 00 41 00 41 00 41 00 41 00 41` (192; 0.500, 1.000, 0.000); `11 d5 11 d5 11 d5 11 d5 11 d5 11 d5 11 d5 11 d5` (65; 0.688, 1.000, 0.469); `21 e5 21 e5 21 e5 21 e5 21 e5 21 e5 21 e5 21 e5` (64; 0.594, 1.000, 0.406); `00 e5 21 e5 21 e5 21 e5 21 e5 21 e5 21 e5 21 e5` (64; 0.609, 1.000, 0.000); `00 d5 11 d5 00 d5 11 d5 11 d5 11 d5 11 d5 00 d5` (64; 0.734, 1.000, 0.000)
- the 64 lines of a world share their first-copier record: distinct first-copier records per world, median 1 (range 1–2)

## Sensitivity (not registered; the scores above use the registered classes only)

- first copier counted only if its copy rate exceeds 0.5 (excludes tapes exactly at the threshold): first copier open on every line in 17 of 17 worlds
- first copier counted only if it also copies itself exactly at least once: first copier open on every line in 17 of 17 worlds

Runtime: 22 s for 17 worlds (classification cached per distinct tape).
